newspec-c: failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））
Re-run 16:47 JST after review; both care settings fail. generateNote failed at B's socket (one call, answered at once). Pass: A's dashboard row sampled every 250 ms never showed Note Ready/Complete (Hospital: Pre-Rounded -> Seen, counts 1/0/1/0; Nursing Home stays Not Yet Prepped, counts 1/1/0/0); typed text kept in the box and stored; no note saved; the Encounter tab has no spinner 10 s after the failure. FAIL (both): the chart never shows the UAT words 'Note not generated' - Hospital Encounter tab says 'The encounter dictation is saved, but the formatted note couldn’t be generated and saved. Tap Generate Note & Finish to retry.', NH 'The visit dictation is saved, but the note couldn’t be generated. Check your connection and tap Generate Note & Finish to retry.'; the Note tab says 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' TC-20 U9 is not gated and quotes the UAT wording, and the matrix oracle is written from it; EFS Q1 / OAT-03 Q3 ask whether other wording may pass - if Quinn accepts the app's wording, only this check changes. FAIL (Hospital): the Post-Round tab shows a disabled button with a spinner, 'Finalizing Encounter Data…', still spinning 10 s later with nothing in flight (PostRoundTab.tsx canFinalize = status === 'note-ready'; any other status renders Loader2). The earlier summary that the tab 'shows only No note generated yet' was wrong. Record-only: the Note tab has no explicit error state (EFS U4b, gated TFA-92595).
产品问题: (1) Hospital and Nursing Home: when note generation fails on both models, the physician never sees 'Note not generated'; the Encounter tab says the formatted note 'couldn’t be generated' and the Note tab says 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' although the encounter was completed. UAT Empty & Failure States state 4 / TFA-94745 state 4, TC-20 U9 (wording question open: EFS Q1 / OAT-03 Q3). (2) Hospital: after the failure the Post-Round tab shows 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' with a spinner that never ends (status stays 'seen'), so the physician is left looking at a busy state with nothing running. UAT 3.5 ('never left waiting with nothing') / OAT-03 ('never an endless spinner'); same screen as EFS U4b (gated TFA-92595).

descriptionHtml:
要人拍板 D7 · P1 · Daniela

笔记生成失败时的文案：UAT 要求「Note not generated」，app 写的是另一套（另外 Post-Round 会一直转「Finalizing…」，这部分归在 B27）

思路 / Approach · TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · S24 「两个模型都生成失败：dashboard 那一行绝不说有记录，病历显示 Note not generated」 Note generation fails on both models: the dashboard row never claims a note, the chart says 'Note not generated'

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U9 When a TC-20 action fails, the screens say so instead of looking current. If note generation fails (main and backup model), the chart shows 'Note not generated' with the dictation kept and the dashbo …（UAT Empty & Failure States；UAT 3.5；UAT OAT-03）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Standard fixture with the Hospital patient pre-rounded and the resident In Today and pending. The note-generation action is made to fail for the main and the backup model (answered with a failure at the Convex socket, the way apps/web/e2e/support/action-observer.ts trackActionRequests({ failFirst }) does, or a local p …

When Tab A shows the dashboard. In tab B type encounter text and tap Generate Note & Finish; wait for the app's failure state. Both care settings

Then Tab A never shows Note Ready on that row. Hospital may show Seen (the dictation was saved); Nursing Home stays Pending (Total 1, Pending 1). The chart shows 'Note not generated' with the encounter dictation kept

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT Empty & Failure States ('Note generation failed: "Note not generated" shown; dictation kept'), UAT 3.5 ('the physician is never left waiting with nothing'), OAT-03. The row badge is judged inside the row (runnerNotes.rowBadge). Nursing Home counts 1/1/0/0. Chart: 'Note not generated' and the typed dictation present. Written from the UAT wording, not from today's error copy

在哪跑：本地 newspec-c（新写的 Playwright）；测试方法 FAULT · 故障注入；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（blocked）

S24 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-20.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：2 条；要拍板的人：Daniela。

问题分类：要人拍板（Daniela） · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94745 ready for qa

笔记生成失败时，Encounter 页写的是「the note couldn't be generated…点重试」，Note 页写的是「No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.」，没有 UAT 要求的「Note not generated」。

When note generation fails, the physician sees 'the note couldn't be generated… tap to retry' on the Encounter tab and 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' on the Note tab, not the UAT's 'Note not generated'.

依据：allure-results/9e250f4b…: generateNote fails at the socket for both models. The dashboard row never claims a note (pass), but the chart never shows 'Note not generated'. Hospital and NH say the note 'couldn't be generated… tap Generate Note & Finish to retry'. The Note tab says 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' The wording question is open: EFS Q1 / OAT-03 Q3, and the OAT-03 knownGap reads 'awaiting Daniela'. The result is labelled UAT only (TC-20 U9); TFA-94745 state 4 holds the wording.

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-92595 in progress

医院笔记生成失败后，Post-Round 页一直在转「Finalizing Encounter Data…」，医生在等一个其实没在运行的东西。

In Hospital, after a failed note generation the Post-Round tab shows a 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' spinner that never stops, so the physician waits on something that is not running.

依据：Same result 9e250f4b…: in Hospital, the Post-Round tab still spins 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' 10 s after the failure, with nothing in flight (PostRoundTab canFinalize only when status is note-ready). Recorded in dev report §5 (copy observation); EFS U4b is gated on TFA-92595 AC 9 (explicit Note-tab error state).

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane newspec-c。

测试方法：FAULT · 故障注入；辅助：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：newspec-c。

UAT item: TC-20 Rounding Dashboard · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-20/S24

Tickets: none (UAT only)

怎么测（newspec-c/plan.json，automatable: yes）：New Playwright spec per care setting: fresh account, Hospital patient pre-rounded (seeded) / resident In Today pending. Page A on the dashboard, page B (same account, second context) types the encounter text and taps Generate Note & Finish with ai/notes:generateNote answered as a failure at B's socket on every attempt (main + backup both fail). Then: A's row never shows Note Ready (row-scoped badge), NH counts Total 1 / Pending 1; B keeps the typed text in the box and stored, no note saved; the chart shows the UAT words 'Note not generated' (judged: TC-20 U9 quotes them, not gated; EFS Q1 / OAT-03 Q3 open); no spinner on the Encounter or the Post-Round tab 10 s after the failure (UAT 3.5 / OAT-03). Note-tab error state recorded only (EFS U4b, gated TFA-92595). — Socket-level failure of the one action and two pages on one account are both available; Generate is pressed only against a failing mock (no model call). Review: the literal wording is judged, not record-only; 'generate' stays in needs in the patch until Quinn confirms.

Detail:

Re-run 16:47 JST after review; both care settings fail. generateNote failed at B's socket (one call, answered at once). Pass: A's dashboard row sampled every 250 ms never showed Note Ready/Complete (Hospital: Pre-Rounded -> Seen, counts 1/0/1/0; Nursing Home stays Not Yet Prepped, counts 1/1/0/0); typed text kept in the box and stored; no note saved; the Encounter tab has no spinner 10 s after the failure. FAIL (both): the chart never shows the UAT words 'Note not generated' - Hospital Encounter tab says 'The encounter dictation is saved, but the formatted note couldn’t be generated and saved. Tap Generate Note & Finish to retry.', NH 'The visit dictation is saved, but the note couldn’t be generated. Check your connection and tap Generate Note & Finish to retry.'; the Note tab says 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' TC-20 U9 is not gated and quotes the UAT wording, and the matrix oracle is written from it; EFS Q1 / OAT-03 Q3 ask whether other wording may pass - if Quinn accepts the app's wording, only this check changes. FAIL (Hospital): the Post-Round tab shows a disabled button with a spinner, 'Finalizing Encounter Data…', still spinning 10 s later with nothing in flight (PostRoundTab.tsx canFinalize = status === 'note-ready'; any other status renders Loader2). The earlier summary that the tab 'shows only No note generated yet' was wrong. Record-only: the Note tab has no explicit error state (EFS U4b, gated TFA-92595).

产品问题：(1) Hospital and Nursing Home: when note generation fails on both models, the physician never sees 'Note not generated'; the Encounter tab says the formatted note 'couldn’t be generated' and the Note tab says 'No note generated yet. Complete the Encounter tab first.' although the encounter was completed. UAT Empty & Failure States state 4 / TFA-94745 state 4, TC-20 U9 (wording question open: EFS Q1 / OAT-03 Q3). (2) Hospital: after the failure the Post-Round tab shows 'Finalizing Encounter Data…' with a spinner that never ends (status stays 'seen'), so the physician is left looking at a busy state with nothing running. UAT 3.5 ('never left waiting with nothing') / OAT-03 ('never an endless spinner'); same screen as EFS U4b (gated TFA-92595).

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A: the step to write is a scripted Playwright spec in tools/qa-agent that makes its own fresh accounts and fails the note-generation action at the Convex socket (fault-ai), the way action-observer.ts does; dev has one shared account, no admin key and no action or socket mock (runner-contract…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
